instruction: Cinematic full shot of an indoor boxing ring. On the left, the trainer in the black and orange jumpsuit (R1) stands facing right, holding up a red focus mitt with her left hand. On the right, the boxer in the white sports bra (R2) stands with her back partially to the camera, extending her right arm to punch the mitt with her black glove. Hanging black punching bags line the background under cool, overhead gym lighting.
